hypothesis: #369 had a real static-cylinder contact. The EGO reference was 0.962 m from the cylinder axis while the matched truth IMU point differed by 0.519 m, but the encounter image and cylinder ROI occupancy were not saved. This observer-only repeat will determine whether cylinder surface evidence appears in the camera and EGO occupied input near the encounter, and whether the command-to-truth deviation recurs.
single_scenario_variable: The observer-only experiment adds camera/depth/color, occupied-cylinder ROI, and same-identity map-query coverage. Before freezing, the user-authorized source cleanup also removed four project-added N05 numeric geometry refusals in vio_ego_bringup.py. The fixed #371 config already satisfies those relations, so the actual planner launch values, mission, world, spawn, box and trigger are unchanged; runtime identity is intentionally new. No control publishers or acceptance thresholds change.
